  - article:

    - text: Same scale
    - paragraph: Both series use the same vertical scale, so heights are directly comparable.
  - article:

    - text: Paired bars
    - paragraph: Bars for the same category stand side by side.
  - article:
    - img
    - text: Gap shows difference
    - paragraph: The vertical gap equals the difference in values.
